description: The oracle never exercises the PROD path. Every behavioral case (test-founder-loop.sh:25,30,35,40,45,50) launches the harness with FOUNDER_TEST=1 + FOUNDER_DIR set. There is (a) no test running the harness with FOUNDER_TEST unset against the real DIR, and (b) no negative test asserting that setting FOUNDER_LEDGER in the environment WITHOUT FOUNDER_TEST does NOT change the goal-checked ledger. Because of this gap the seam leak in FIND-901 passes the suite silently. The static checks (lines 15-20) also do not assert that the harness's FOUNDER_LEDGER read is FOUNDER_TEST-gated, even though the sibling recorder suite enforces exactly that for record-earn.mjs (test-record-earn.sh:18-20). A money-loop oracle that cannot distinguish prod from test cannot fence INV-H2/INV-H5 in prod.

evidence.snippet: OUT="$(FOUNDER_TEST=1 FOUNDER_DIR="$T" ... bash "$H" 2>&1)"  # every behavioral case sets FOUNDER_TEST=1; prod path untested

fix: Add (1) a STATIC check mirroring test-record-earn.sh:18-20 that any process-affecting env seam in founder-loop.sh (FOUNDER_LEDGER, FOUNDER_DIR) is FOUNDER_TEST-gated; (2) a BEHAVIORAL prod-leak test: with FOUNDER_TEST unset but FOUNDER_LEDGER=<attacker file containing earn_usdc:999>, point DIR at a temp via a permitted prod-safe override and assert the harness's realised_earn_usdc reflects the recorder's real ledger ($0), never 999.
